messages.subject: Greetings
messages.body_plain:
Dear Mr./Ms.,

We are seeking reliable suppliers, contractors, service providers, Agent and other partners to participate in global tenders.
We invite your company to register as a supplier for AIR INDIA 2026/2027 procurement projects.

If interested, please request our Vendor Questionnaire and EOI.
We look forward to your prompt response.

Kind Regards,
Mr. Rohit Kumar
Email ,rohitkum...@gmail.com

Procurement Coordinator
AIR INDIA
Block-4, Vatika One on One, Sector-16, NH-48, Industrial Estate, Gurugram, Haryana, 122007, India.
